payload.summary: From Jim (2026-07-29, log only — no action now): when a tool in the loop fails strangely, agents silently ABANDON the nahel workflow instead of erroring inside it. Real incident on speed-count-game: rtk 0.36 had a slash-ref bug that suppressed git diff output (empty diffs; fixed in rtk 0.44.1) plus a cursor sandbox permission issue — codex, instead of surfacing the failure and parking, kicked out of the nahel flow, worked with cursor directly, and cursor committed to main in the shared working tree (no worktree, coordination hazard). Desired behavior: tool failure inside a nahel run -> journal the failure, park or hand back per the workflow — never freestyle outside the trail. Likely levers: afk-run/review-loop workflow language (explicit fail-inside-the-flow instruction to workers), maybe a dispatch-brief line. Jims verbatim conclusions from the rtk investigation: empty diffs fixed by RTK upgrade; unattended nahel dispatch keeps cursors --force --sandbox enabled --trust; increased file count was expected from nahel routing and review-trail commits; no repo config change needed. Related: [[dispatch-sandbox-preflight]] f35q1rax.
